requirements.title: User Registration
requirements.description: The system shall allow new users to register with email, password, and full name. Email must be unique.

requirements.title: User Login
requirements.description: The system shall authenticate users with email and password, returning a session token on success.

requirements.title: Product Listing
requirements.description: The system shall return a paginated list of available products with name, price, and stock status.

requirements.title: Product Detail
requirements.description: The system shall return full product details including description, images, and available inventory count.

requirements.title: Add to Cart
requirements.description: The system shall allow authenticated users to add products to their shopping cart with a specified quantity.

requirements.title: View Cart
requirements.description: The system shall return the current cart contents with line-item totals and grand total for the authenticated user.

requirements.title: Place Order
requirements.description: The system shall convert a user's cart into an order, assign an order ID, and set status to PENDING.

requirements.title: Order Confirmation Email
requirements.description: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the user immediately after a successful order placement.

requirements.title: Payment Processing
requirements.description: The system shall charge the user's payment method upon order placement and record the transaction ID.

requirements.title: Inventory Reservation
requirements.description: The system shall reserve stock for each ordered item upon order placement to prevent overselling.

requirements.title: Order Status Tracking
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to retrieve their order status (PENDING, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED).

requirements.title: Order History
requirements.description: The system shall return a paginated list of all past orders for an authenticated user.

requirements.title: Order Cancellation
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to cancel an order that is in PENDING or PROCESSING status.

requirements.title: Payment Refund on Cancellation
requirements.description: The system shall issue a full refund to the user's payment method when an order is cancelled.

requirements.title: Inventory Release on Cancellation
requirements.description: The system shall release reserved inventory back to available stock when an order is cancelled.

requirements.title: Shipping Status Update
requirements.description: The system shall update order status to SHIPPED and record the tracking number when fulfilment confirms shipment.

requirements.title: Cancellation Confirmation Email
requirements.description: The system shall send a cancellation confirmation email to the user when an order is cancelled, including the order ID and refund amount.

requirements.title: Product Search
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to search products by keyword, returning results ranked by relevance.

requirements.title: Return Request
requirements.description: The system shall allow users to submit a return request for a delivered order within 30 days of delivery.

requirements.title: Low Stock Alert
requirements.description: The system shall send an internal alert when a product's stock drops below 10 units.
